title: Advancing CFET Device Roadmap with Novel Integration Modules
summary: Pioneering work develops critical CFET modules including an improved backside contact module and a novel gate stack for threshold voltage tuning.

title: US Army Approves 20 Nuclear Micro-Reactors on Bases
summary: The US Army authorized the construction of up to 20 nuclear micro-reactors across domestic military bases to provide reliable power.

title: New GaN-on-Si Transistor Withstands Nearly 4kV
summary: A new Intrinsic Polarisation Super Junction transistor has been invented to prevent GaN transistor failures at very high voltages.

title: Karst Collapse Risk Assessment for Urban Metro Engineering
summary: Researchers propose an integrated framework combining geological characterization and hydrodynamic simulation to assess karst collapse risks in urban metro engineering.

title: Porous Liquid Crystal Elastomers for Tunable Acoustics
summary: Porous liquid crystal elastomers with reversible thermal-driven pore structures enable wide-range acoustic tuning and dynamic sound regulation.

title: Electronegative Linker Engineering in MOFs for Catalysis
summary: Researchers designed Pt@UiO-66-X model catalysts to reveal how organic ligand electronegativity enhances H2O2 activation for pesticide detection.

title: Back-Analysis Method for Shear Strength in Slopes
summary: A new upper-bound back-analysis method uses slip surface continuity to determine shear strength parameters in double-layered slopes.

title: Passive Suppression of Gradual Opening in Wave Rotors
summary: An unpartitioned inlet duct design improves fuel mixing and suppresses the gradual opening effect in wave rotor combustors.

title: Limit-State Capacity Sampling in Seismic Fragility
summary: A unified probabilistic framework compares capacity sampling models to prevent systematic biases in simulation-based seismic damage distributions.

title: Gate-Side Hydrogen Regulation in ITO FETs
summary: An in-situ NiO interlayer regulates gate-side hydrogen to significantly reduce threshold-voltage shifts in ITO field-effect transistors.

title: Phosphorylated Chitin Composite for Bone Repair
summary: A novel composite integrating phosphorylated chitin with hydroxyapatite promotes angiogenesis and osteogenesis for effective bone defect repair.

title: Portable Micro-Indentation Instrument for Structures
summary: A new portable micro-indentation instrument accurately tests the mechanical properties of in-service engineering structures with high-resolution depth measurement.

title: Predicting Soil Plug Development in Steel Pipe Piles
summary: The coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian method is used to investigate soil plug development and penetration resistance for large-diameter steel pipe piles in clay.

title: Digital Image Correlation Improves Concrete Model Validation
summary: Researchers compared concrete constitutive models using digital image correlation and found that the strain-dependent Massicotte model aligns best with experimental crack patterns.

title: Optimizing High-Speed Railway Turnout Stiffness
summary: A modified genetic algorithm optimizes high-speed rail turnout stiffness, improving mechanical performance and reducing wheel-rail contact forces.

title: Analyzing Stability Switching in BAM Neural Networks
summary: This article investigates stability switching and Hopf bifurcation in fractional-order bidirectional associative memory neural networks featuring higher-order interactions.

title: Geopolymer-Stabilized Pond Ash for Pavements
summary: Studies show that geopolymer additives improve the hydromechanical properties of pond ash, making it a sustainable and effective pavement base material.

title: Automating Numerical Analysis in Geotechnical Design
summary: An AI-assisted workflow integrating Python and finite element modeling automates geotechnical analyses to improve design efficiency and evaluate hundreds of scenarios.

title: Skild AI Unveils S1 Robot Foundation Model
summary: Skild AI launched its S1 robot foundation model, enabling robots to learn new tasks from demonstration videos.

title: Siemens Launches Eigen Engineering Agent in Thailand
summary: Siemens launched an AI tool that connects with TIA Portal to support PLC coding, HMI visualization, and device configuration.

title: Massive Thermal Anomaly Discovered Beneath Martian Surface
summary: Researchers discovered a large thermal anomaly under the surface of Mars, highlighting the planet's two distinct halves.

title: Advanced Cooling Technologies Tackle Automotive Heat Challenge
summary: New cooling solutions are being developed to manage rising heat fluxes driven by electric drivetrains, AI processors, and autonomous systems.

title: Elastocaloric Cooling Proposed to Replace Aircon
summary: Elastocaloric cooling uses mechanical stress on shape memory alloys like nitinol to generate air conditioning using minimal electricity.

title: Alkali Activators in Fly Ash Geopolymer Concrete
summary: Study examines how sodium hydroxide and sodium silicate ratios affect the mechanical and durability properties of fly ash-based geopolymer concrete.

title: Self-Balancing Electric Unicycle Developed
summary: Researchers designed a self-balancing electric unicycle using an open-source motor controller, IMU sensor, and PID control algorithm.

title: Mechanical Behaviour of Pipeline-Mounted Assemblies during S-Lay
summary: Parametric finite element analyses characterize how pipeline-mounted structural assemblies amplify strain during stinger passage.

title: AI Prediction of Oil Formation Volume Factor
summary: Super Learner and Deep Neural Network algorithms were trained to forecast oil formation volume factor for Niger Delta reservoir fluids.

title: Machine Learning Prediction of Gas-Oil Ratio
summary: Machine learning models were trained to predict the solution gas-oil ratio for Niger Delta reservoir fluids below bubble point pressure.

title: Hybrid HBM-HBF Architecture Proposed for LLM Inference
summary: Oxford researchers published a paper on using High-Bandwidth Flash alongside High-Bandwidth Memory to address capacity limitations in LLM inference systems.

title: M3D 6T SRAM With BEOL Pass-Gates Developed for 2nm Node
summary: Researchers from Georgia Tech and Synopsys proposed a monolithic-3D 6T SRAM for the 2nm node integrating BEOL IGO pass-gates.
